title.narrative: Program Title: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV in the Democratic Republic of Congo - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), Tuberculosis, Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Security (MOH DRC)This program has the following goals: Contribute to accelerating progress towards the end of the TB epidemic in the DRC / Contribuer à l'accéleration du progrès vers la fin de l'épidemie de la TB en RDC. Controlling the HIV epidemic by 2025 in the DRC / Contrôle de l'épidémie du VIH à l'horizon 2025 en RDC. The objectives of this program are: Screen a cumulative total of 691338 cases of TB all forms within the framework of the NMF3 among which 71,987 children and 6,330 cases of MDR TB / Dépister un total cumulé de 691338 cas de TB toutes formes dans le cadre du NMF3 parmi lequel 71987 enfants et 6330 cas de TBMR. Treat successfully at least 95% of notified TB patients and at least 72% of notified MDR TB / Traiter avec succès au moins 95% des patients TB PS notifiés et au moins 72 % des TB MR notifiés;. Put on treatment of latent infection children under 5 years of age in contact with TB + cases excluded from TB (126474) / Mettre sous traitement d’infection latente enfants de moins de 5 ans en contact avec des cas TB+ exclue de la TB (126474) ;. Test at least 90% of TB patients notified during the period for HIV; / Tester au VIH au moins 90% des patients tuberculeux notifiés durant la période ;. Put on ARV treatment 100% of co-infected patients (TB HIV +) during the period in the country / Mettre sous ARV 100% des patients coïnfectés (TB VIH+) durant la période dans le pays ;

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for COD-T-MOHP03
Percentage of facilities that receive supportive supervision - at least once per quarter
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
TCP-6b other 1: Number of cases of tuberculosis (all forms combined) declared in key populations / high-risk groups, namely children aged 0-14 years (excluding prison population)
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among key affected populations/ high risk groups (other than prisoners)
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
PSM-4 other 1: Percentage of health facilities with tracer drugs for tuberculosis on the day of the visit or the report

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Outcome indicators targets and results for COD-T-MOHP03
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Impact indicators targets and results for COD-T-MOHP03
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
TB/HIV mortality rate per 100,000 population
